title: Welder/Fabricator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
A Welder/Fabricator in a Steel Engineering Company plays a crucial role in the process of turning raw steel materials into usable components for various construction and engineering projects. Their responsibilities encompass a range of tasks related to cutting, shaping, assembling, and welding steel pieces to create structural and architectural elements. Key roles and responsibilities of a Steel Fabricator: Material Preparation: Review engineering drawings, blueprints, and specifications to understand the required dimensions and tolerances. Select appropriate steel materials based on project requirements and specifications. Measure and mark steel pieces for cutting and shaping using tools such as tape measures, squares, and marking devices. Cutting and Shaping: Operate various cutting equipment, such as saws, shears, plasma cutters, and torches, to cut steel pieces according to the provided specifications. Use bending machines, presses, and rollers to shape steel components as required by the design. 3. Welding and Assembly: Assemble steel components by welding, bolting, riveting, or other joining methods specified in the engineering plans. Perform welding using different techniques such as MIG (Metal Inert Gas), TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas), and stick welding, ensuring strong and durable connections. Ensure proper alignment, fit, and finish of assembled components, maintaining structural integrity and aesthetic appearance. Quality Control: Inspect fabricated parts for accuracy, quality, and conformance to specifications. Identify and address any defects, inconsistencies, or imperfections in the fabrication process. Conduct quality checks using measuring tools like calipers, gauges, and squares. Safety and Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines while working with heavy machinery, cutting tools, and welding equipment. Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure personal safety and prevent workplace accidents. Follow industry standards and regulations to ensure that the fabricated components meet required codes and standards. Collaboration: Communicate with engineers, designers, and other team members to clarify design details and resolve any issues that arise during fabrication. Collaborate with other fabricators and tradespeople to coordinate the assembly and installation of larger structures. Maintenance and Troubleshooting: Perform routine maintenance on fabrication equipment to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Troubleshoot and address equipment malfunctions or breakdowns to minimize downtime. Documentation: Maintain accurate records of materials used, time spent, and work completed for each project. Document any modifications or changes made during the fabrication process. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on advancements in fabrication techniques, equipment, and materials to enhance skills and knowledge.

title: direttore commerciale/direttrice commerciale
description: Per una PMI italiana in forte crescita nell'ambito dell' automazione industriale, ricerchiamo la figura di un Sales Manager- Automazione Industriale per guidare l'evoluzione dell'area commerciale da modello 'imprenditoriale' a struttura scalabile e data-driven. Chi è il nostro cliente Realtà che opera tra Automazione industriale e sicurezza di macchine/impianti, con un posizionamento da partner tecnico-consulenziale: integra componenti tecnologiche e un portafoglio di servizi specialistici. La sfida Inserimento con affiancamento iniziale alla Direzione Commerciale, pensato come transizione concreta e rapida verso la guida dell'Area Sales. Cerchiamo una figura già strutturata, capace di portare metodo, KPI, organizzazione e leadership positiva, incidendo direttamente su processi, rete vendita e crescita. E' una persona che non si staccherà dal business, al contrario contribuirà direttamente insieme al team alla crescita e allo sviluppo commerciale dell'azienda. Responsabilità Coordinare e affiancare team commerciale interno e rete di agenti/partner nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità. Definire (con la Direzione) obiettivi, priorità e piano commerciale; monitorare avanzamento e scostamenti. Gestire e sviluppare direttamente alcuni clienti strategici. Identificare nuovi segmenti, casi d'uso e soluzioni da introdurre (approccio 'business development'). Promuovere l'uso del CRM e la qualità della pipeline (forecast, next step, copertura). Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede: Milano Nord Est Modalità: presenza in sede + attività sul territorio Orario: full time Trasferte: frequenti su territorio nazionale RAL: 50.000 - 65.000 € (in base a esperienza e competenze, criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere) CCNL: Commercio Inquadramento: Quadro Variabile/benefit:MBO (premio variabile) Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo Ticket Restaurant Welfare: 2,5 mensilità #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. 3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)

Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.

remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.

kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) in Mamer

OG Recruitment is your consulting agency for the recruitment of specialists in Luxembourg and the entire border region. We are exclusively concerned with direct placements with our clients. No temporary employment.

On behalf of our renowned client with headquarters in Mamer (L) we are looking for an Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) for mechanical and electrical satellite systems.

The position will be filled directly and permanent with the client.

Our client is an innovative, Luxembourg based high-tech company with several state-of-the-art divisions.

Your tasks

- Design electrical installations and controller solutions for the satellite ground segment and the rubber industry testing equipment:
- Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products,
- Create electrical concepts and drawings,
- Identify, assess and mitigate safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and define electrical safety concepts to address those,
- Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components.
- Interact with internal & external customers and suppliers in order to promote, improve and troubleshoot the customers electrical and automated solutions:
- Present, explain and defend important features and concepts in discussions with the customers and use their feedback to improve and troubleshoot the products,
- Interact with suppliers to select components and perform obsolescence management.

Your profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or automation engineering
- 3 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field of activity, including good understanding of electrical and electro-mechanical installations and power electronics
- Design of electrical installations, including electro-mechanical devices such as motors, and related drawings (EPLAN P8)
- Ability to perform safety analyses of electro-mechanical machinery (using tools such as Safexpert, Sistema) and to design electrical systems fulfilling the common safety norms (such as the machinery directive 2006/42/EC)
- PLC software development is considered a plus (e.g. PLCopen Structured Text ST)
- Good team spirit
- Ability to adapt to new situations and work with various type of stakeholders and partners to achieve the desired results
- Ability to work in an English-speaking environment including technical discussions and documentation activities, German, French and Luxembourgish being considered as a plus

What we offer

- A permanent employment contract directly with the client
- Attractive salary
- Great working atmosphere and modern, multi national working environment
- Dynamic environment
- Attractive career development opportunities

How it proceeds

- You are welcome to apply online and click on the "Apply" button
- If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us by phone or e-mail.
- We will review your documents and arrange a telephone call or personal meeting to get to know you.

Discretion comes first

- We guarantee the utmost confidentiality of your application.
- We work responsibly in accordance with the GDPR.

Sounds good? Then apply now. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects I (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

XXXX-112 Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
69,000 - 77,000 € per year

Who we are

XXXX (XXXX) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. XXXX enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The XXXX service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, XXXX will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. You will support flagship projects such as but not limited to, HDAB2-LU, which is enabling the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and laying the foundations for a robust health data ecosystem aligned with European data-sharing frameworks.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will contribute to the development of data governance practices, data access services, and project-related solutions that facilitate secure data sharing, strengthen health and research data ecosystems, and promote the responsible adoption of trustworthy AI. Your work will directly contribute to XXXX's mission of unlocking the value of data while ensuring transparency, compliance, and public trust.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will drive the development and delivery of the data access request management capacity. This includes the collection and validation of access conditions from different data providers, standardising the information into data request application form, defining the access review procedure and SOPs, compiling requirements of data access management tools, supporting the implementation of the tools to and implementing the data access request management workflows in the tools. You will work with the other project team members from XXXX, including Project Coordinator, Work Package Leaders, Data Protection Officer (DPO) and ethical, legal and societal implications (ELSI) experts to implement the required compliance measures related to the projects. Finally, you will interact with the information security, technology, and data teams to ensure adequate design and delivery of services.

What you will do

• Develop and deliver XXXX' DM/DS services within the scope of the projects
• Contribute to other services and the maintenance of XXXX' DM/DS toolbox.
• Develop guidelines on data management, stewardship and protection for the projects
• Contribute to the XXXX' Data Catalogue by populating, curating, and updating metadata related to data custodians, provenance and use restrictions for datasets of the projects
• Implement necessary General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) accountability measures for data processing activities involving personal data required by the projects
• Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for data processing activities concerning sensitive data for the projects
• Provide training on DM/DS best practices, tools, and related to the DS services of the projects
• Develop internal processes and guidelines to support relevant information security and data protection compliances and certifications related to the projects
• Engage in (inter-)national projects related to DM/DS service development related to the projects
• Train and supervise less experienced team members working on the projects

Who you are

• MSc or PhD in natural science or technology, or social science with technical skills.
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, including relevant ones in the following areas:
          - data stewardship
          - data management
          - community coordination, outreach and training.
• Working knowledge in data lifecycle management, FAIR data principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse) and the GDPR
• Experience in technical writing (white papers, documentation, reports, policies) and content for dissemination to stakeholders and the public (online guides, tutorials)
• Good working knowledge of one programming language (Python or R)
• Good working knowledge of command line shell (any OS)
• Good working knowledge of basic website authoring (markdown, jinja, HTML)
• Proven experience in one of the following topics:
          - Ethical, legal and societal implications in data-driven research projects
          - Designing and implementing organisational risk management processes
          - Data requests management of sensitive data
          - DPIA
         - Community building and management
• Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
• Service and collaborative attitude
• Ability and willingness to interact closely with stakeholders
• Ability to handle multiple assignments while working independently and effectively under deadlines

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The XXXX is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join XXXX and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

Apply now!

XXXX as well as all related entities do not accept any candidate submission from unsolicited third parties. Candidates presented by unsolicited third parties (such as recruitment agencies, head hunters etc.), will not be entered into the recruitment process and will not be considered further. Further on, no contractual relationship will result out of such a submission between XXXX and a third party. XXXX is not obligated nor willing to pay any fee to third parties submitting candidates in this manner. Your data is handled according to the compliance guidelines of XXXX.

Data Processing:
XXXX is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing equal access to employment opportunities to all prospective employees within the recruitment process. XXXX complies with and supports all national and local laws pertaining to non-discrimination. Please note that XXXX is supported by Serendi for Talent Acquisition Services. title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Senior infrastructure Engineer (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description:


How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organizational activities.

Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:

·          Administer, maintain and continuously improve LIST's backup, storage and file-service infrastructure.
·          Operate the Commvault backup platform, including policies, schedules, retention, reporting and capacity management.
·          Monitor backup jobs, perform recovery tests, and support disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·          Administer storage infrastructure and file services supporting SMB shares, VMware and other infrastructure workloads.
·          Manage storage capacity, performance, availability, resilience, data protection and lifecycle activities.
·          Monitor infrastructure hardware and services, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup and network-related components.
·          Maintain relevant monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, service indicators, thresholds and operational reports.
·          Investigate and troubleshoot incidents, failures, alerts, performance issues, capacity constraints and hardware problems.
·          Perform or coordinate upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, replacements and decommissioning.
·          Contribute to capacity planning, performance optimization, service continuity and infrastructure architecture improvements.
·          Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, dependencies, recovery requirements and escalation paths.



Additional infrastructure responsibilities:

Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also provide support for:

·          Active Directory operations, including user and computer administration, group management, access control and directory hygiene.
·          Telephony and unified-communications services, including operational support, maintenance, lifecycle activities and service improvements.

You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Information Security, Applications and Development teams, researchers, external service providers and other stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable and efficient IT services


Project delivery and activity management:

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritizing tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field experience


Experience and skills:

·          Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or a comparable IT environment.
·          Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise backup and recovery platforms, preferably Commvault.
·          Practical experience with backup policies, retention, monitoring, recovery procedures, recovery testing and disaster-recovery operations.
·          Experience administering or supporting enterprise storage systems, file services and storage technologies for virtualisation or infrastructure workloads.
·          Experience with infrastructure monitoring, including service availability, hardware health, capacity, performance and alert management.
·          Experience with infrastructure maintenance, lifecycle management, patching, vulnerability remediation and service continuity.
·          Experience supporting Active Directory or other identity and directory services is an advantage.
·          Experience with VMware or comparable virtualisation technologies is an advantage.
·          Experience operating or supporting enterprise telephony, unified communications or related services is an advantage.
·          Good understanding of infrastructure-security practices, including hardening, access control, vulnerability remediation, encryption and data protection.
·          Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and firewalls.
·          Experience with scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or equivalent is an advantage.
·          Experience supporting cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
·          Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·          Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.


Soft skills:

·          Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·          Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·          Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate and report on activities.
·          Strong documentation, communication, planning and organizational skills.
·          Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·          Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·          Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·          Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.


Language skills:

•               Fluency in English (Luxembourgish, German and especially French are considered as an asset), both oral and written.


Your LIST benefits:

·          An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·          Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·          An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·          Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers


Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
·          Contact details of 2 references


Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

title: Lead System Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Entwicklung – Luxemburg / Remote (1720) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

Sie sind interessiert?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an:
bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller

Umfang: Maximal 70%

title: Lead Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Qualitätssicherung – Luxemburg / Remote (1719) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description:
Ihre Karriere in der Produktqualität elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Qualitätssicherung komplexer Automotive-Systeme. Sie analysieren kritische Produktprobleme, steuern strukturierte Ursachenanalysen und entwickeln nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Fehleranalyse: Sie leiten komplexe Ursachenanalysen mit Methoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa und begleiten die Bearbeitung kritischer Produktprobleme
- Qualitätsverbesserung: Sie erkennen wiederkehrende Fehler- und Qualitätstrends und leiten nachhaltige Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen ab
- Produktqualität: Sie unterstützen Entwicklungsteams bei der Verbesserung von Produktsicherheit, Entwicklungsqualität und Prozesskonformität
- Datenanalyse: Sie analysieren Qualitäts- und Fehlerdaten, identifizieren systemische Schwachstellen und schaffen die Grundlage für gezielte Optimierungen
- Problemlösung: Sie koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Teams bei der Bearbeitung interner sowie kundenseitiger Qualitätsprobleme und unterstützen die Priorisierung kritischer Fehler
- Kundenkommunikation: Sie begleiten die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden bei kritischen Produktproblemen und den daraus resultierenden Korrekturmaßnahmen
- Methodenkompetenz: Sie vermitteln Best Practices der strukturierten Problemlösung und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungs- und Qualitätsmethoden

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld sowie erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Qualitätsmethoden: Praxiserfahrung mit strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering sowie relevanten Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

Sie sind interessiert?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an:
bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller
