title: IT Support for Cibes Lift Group
description:
Hey there! Ready to dive into the world of IT support? Kickstart your IT career as IT Support at Cibes Lift Group!



<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/b4f5669c-9516-48f5-971e-2c4fdc6049d4.jpg">

Have you recently completed an IT education at high school level or higher and are looking for your first step into the world of IT? This could be it. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, service-minded team member to join Cibes Lift Group as our new IT Support team member, and you might be exactly who we're looking for!

Your mission? Providing technical assistance to clients and internal users, whether it's face-to-face, over the phone, or through remote tools. You'll be our go-to support expert, solving problems, diagnosing issues, and using your technical curiosity and skills to save the day.

You'll also be the go-to person for software and hardware support, handling password resets, managing user accounts, and contributing to our IT security initiatives and policies. Here's the kicker: you'll never be bored. With our ever-evolving operations, your role will constantly adapt, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges and explore new technologies. And remember, you won't be doing it alone. You'll be part of a team of three IT Support professionals who work closely together to support both each other and the business.

So, who are we looking for? You're the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. You know your way around Windows systems, and when it comes to communication, you'll need to be comfortable communicating in both English and Swedish, whether you're chatting face-to-face or shooting off an email. You'll also need to hold a permanent work permit in Sweden to be considered for this position.

But it's not just about technical skills. We're looking for someone who is structured, a great team player, and patient when it comes to troubleshooting. You genuinely enjoy helping people, and nothing is more rewarding than finding the solution that makes someone's day a little easier.

Sound like you? If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, take on new challenges, and be part of an awesome team, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's make some IT magic happen together!

Application
In this recruitment, Cibes Lift Group is partnering with Jefferson Wells. Jefferson Wells manages the recruitment process, but the successful candidate will be employed directly by Cibes Lift Group. For questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se or +46 70 377 06 64. Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To apply, please submit your application through our recruitment system.

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter telling us why you're interested in the role and how your experience and background make you a great fit. Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 5 November, 2026. Selection will take place continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Cibes Lift Group is one of the world's most innovative manufacturers of space-saving lifts designed for fast and easy installation, also offering a wide range of conventional lift solutions. Thanks to the wide range of lift products and a flexible design concept, the lift solutions of Cibes Lift Group adapt to the requirements of public, commercial, and private settings. Sales, installation, and maintenance services are provided by a global network of subsidiaries and partners. The company group is headquartered in Gävle, Sweden, and has production facilities in Sweden, Poland, China, and USA. In 2026 the Group had approximately 1980 employees and a revenue of 3,6 billion SEK.

title: Manager Audit Analytics & Data Insights | Assurance |  Stockholm

As a Manager in Audit Analytics & Data Insights, you will lead analytics delivery across audit and assurance engagements.     Oversee the extraction, transformation and analysis of large datasets using SQL, Databricks and Alteryx.
    Develop and automate scalable, reusable workflows that improve audit efficiency, consistency and coverage.
    Lead the development of dashboards and visualizations in Power BI or comparable tools.
    Review data quality, reconciliations, trend analysis, exception reporting, testing and documentation.
    Manage analytics workstreams, timelines and resources, and coach Senior Associates and junior colleagues.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Do you want to build modern software for critical logistics and transportation processes, and follow the customer all the way from need to result?

At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that support warehousing, transportation management, delivery visibility, and checkout experiences, used every day by leading retailers and logistics providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands the customer’s world, can turn needs into precise requirements, and takes responsibility for what ships. You will work the way modern teams do, with AI as a natural part of how software gets built.

About the Role

You will be a natural part of the customer’s whole journey, from onboarding new customers to supporting and maintaining existing ones. Most of your time will be spent designing, developing, and improving our products and integrations, while also supporting customers and colleagues when technical expertise is needed.

Unlike a traditional in-house development role, you will work directly with customers, particularly within integrations and technical onboarding in real-world logistics operations. You will work on new functionality, integrations, technical improvements, troubleshooting, and the continuous development of our solutions, in a cross-functional team with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers.

You will work with modern SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, distributed integrations, and business-critical systems that process large volumes of transactions every day. Our solutions are built on technologies including .NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript, Azure, and modern web frameworks, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Industrial Engineer, you will play a key role in a smaller production unit where your work has a direct impact on our business. With short decision-making paths, your ideas can quickly become tangible improvements.

You will be an important part of our production engineering development, with the opportunity to take ideas and analyses all the way through to implemented solutions that make a measurable difference. Your responsibilities include:

    Solving problems cross-functionally together with relevant stakeholders, including production, quality, logistics, maintenance, engineering and IT

    A university degree in engineering or equivalent experience, preferably within industrial, mechanical or electrical engineering
    A strong technical interest; experience in production engineering is an advantage
    Experience leading or contributing to projects
    An interest in IT-related solutions
    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

To succeed in this role, you:

    Are solution-oriented and enjoy taking on technical challenges
    Show drive, initiative and a genuine desire to make a difference
    Thrive in a cross-functional environment and build strong working relationships
    Take ownership and deliver high-quality results

title: SAP Solution Architect
description:

We work in an open and friendly way, where we support each other to ensure we provide the best possible solutions for our users. As SAP Solution Architect, you will design and govern SAP solutions that align with business strategy while ensuring scalable, future-proof architecture.



You will translate business requirements into SAP functional and technical designs.



Ensure integration across SAP modules and surrounding systems.



Standardization and template based delivery is important factors for the SAP environment.



You should be updated on new technology and functionality that can improve the solution.

Profile description:

Your profileYou have an experience within SAP ERP Solutions.



You have a University Degree or similar knowledge gained through work experience. Experience with leading teams is beneficial.  



You have more than 4 years of experience within an IT area in an international company.



As for your personal skills we are looking for someone who is goal orientated, fast learner and eager to learn along the way.



You are able to adopt new technologies and tools when needed, open-minded to enjoy intellectual sparring and knowledge sharing.



The job requires a lot of collaboration both internally and externally so good interpersonal and communications skills are a prerequisite to be successful in the role.



We also expect you to have good analytical and administration skills. Location and travel

International travel will be part of the role.



Application and contactsIn this recruitment process we review applications continuously and we may close the process before the last application day.







A hybrid workplace



Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility and participation allowing for a better balance between work and private life, which also promotes well-being.



At the same time, we value in-person collaboration and team connection. Therefore, we expect our employees to be present in the office at least three days per week, with flexibility for remote work during the remaining working days, depending on business needs and role requirements.

Senior IT Systems \& Network Administrator
==========================================

Position Summary
----------------

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT professional to take operational ownership of the school's day\-to\-day IT environment.

This is a senior, campus\- based technical position combining systems administration, enterprise networking and high\-quality user support.

The successful candidate will independently diagnose and resolve complex incidents, maintain the reliability of core IT services and anticipate issues before they disrupt teaching and learning.

They will serve as a key on\-site IT contact for staff and work closely with Regional and Global IT teams, following Group technical standards, security policies and change\-management procedures.

The role requires sound technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to plan, prioritise and

deliver work with limited day\-to\-day supervision. It is a hands\-on position rather than a people\-management role.



Key Responsibilities

**Campus IT Operations \& Technical Ownership**

* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campus IT operations, from incident triage and diagnosis through resolution, documentation and follow\-up.
* Independently prioritise support requests and operational tasks, with particular urgency for incidents affecting lessons, examinations and essential school services.
* Proactively monitor recurring issues, service health and technology risks; recommend and implement practical improvements within delegated authority.
* Act as the senior on\-site technical contact, coordinating with school stakeholders, IT colleagues and external suppliers; escalate significant incidents with clear technical evidence and business impact.


**Systems, Microsoft 365 \& Identity Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, licences, role\-appropriate access permissions, authentication and account lifecycle processes.
* Operate and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online, including mailboxes, collaboration services and access\-related incidents.
* Support secure identity practices, including MFA, access controls and the implementation of centrally defined security policies.
* Investigate service degradation, authentication failures and device\-to\-cloud integration issues, identifying root causes and implementing controlled fixes.


**Endpoint \& Device Management**

* Administer Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, device configuration, application deployment, policy application and troubleshooting.
* Support Apple Macs and iPads through Jamf and maintain compliant, reliable device configurations in accordance with Group standards.
* Manage provisioning, deployment, replacement, patching and end\-of\-life processes for staff and shared school devices.


**Networking \& Infrastructure**

* Provide hands\-on operation and advanced troubleshooting of the campus wired and wireless network, including switches, access points, network connectivity and related services.
* Use Cisco Meraki management and diagnostic tools, where authorised, to investigate client connectivity, switch ports, Wi\-Fi performance and infrastructure alerts.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, wireless authentication and Internet connectivity; distinguish endpoint, local\-network and upstream service faults.
* Carry out approved network changes, equipment replacements and site deployments in coordination with Regional or Global IT; maintain accurate configurations and documentation.
* Work with connectivity and network service providers to restore service and prevent repeat incidents.


**User Support \& Classroom Technology**

* Provide second\-line and senior escalation support for complex Windows, Microsoft 365, endpoint, classroom AV/interactive display and peripheral issues, while remaining responsive to urgent day\-to\-day support needs.
* Help teachers and staff use school technology effectively; communicate incident status and practical workarounds in accessible, non\-technical language.
* Support PaperCut MF / Find\-Me printing and cloud telephony, coordinating specialist suppliers where required.


**Security, Documentation \& Projects**

* Maintain IT asset records, operational procedures, technical documentation and useful knowledge\-base articles.
* Contribute to refresh programmes, upgrades, onboarding/offboarding and continuous improvement projects, managing assigned on\-site activities autonomously.
* Apply information\-security, privacy and safeguarding requirements; identify and promptly escalate security incidents or risks in line with established procedures.




**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Typically 5\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience in IT support, systems administration or network operations, including demonstrable responsibility for independently managing a business or campus IT environment. Equivalent experience will be considered.
* Strong practical experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity/access management and troubleshooting Exchange Online services.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows device management using Microsoft Intune, including configuration and deployment workflows.
* Solid enterprise networking knowledge and evidence of resolving real\-world issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, Wi\-Fi and network access.
* Proven ability to investigate and resolve incidents end\-to\-end, identify root causes, assess service impact and escalate efficiently when an issue exceeds the role's authority or scope.
* Ability to work independently on\-site, organise competing priorities, communicate clearly with non\-technical users and coordinate vendors and remote technical teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English (at least B2; C1 preferred).


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

* Hands\-on administration or support of Cisco Meraki switches, wireless access points and security appliances.
* Experience using Jamf School or Jamf Pro to manage Apple Macs and iPads.
* Experience with MFA, Microsoft Conditional Access, endpoint security, PowerShell or practical IT automation.
* Familiarity with PaperCut MF, Find\-Me printing and cloud\-based VoIP services.
* Previous experience in international education or another multi\-user, service\-critical environment.
* Relevant Microsoft or networking certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365/Endpoint Administrator or CCNA), or equivalent proven expertise.
* French proficiency (B1 or above preferred; B2 a strong advantage).




**Safeguarding \& Professional Conduct**

The successful candidate must uphold the school's commitments to safeguarding and the welfare of children and young people, protect confidential information, and follow applicable data protection and information\-security policies. Appointment is subject to the relevant pre\-employment checks and applicable Swiss legal requirements.

JOB PURPOSE =========== To provide safe, high\\-quality, evidence\\-based nursing care to students and emergency response to staff, and visitors within an international and boarding school environment during the main school and also the Summer Camp. The School Nurse is responsible for assessing and managing illness and injury, providing emergency and first\\-aid care, administering medications and treatments, coordinating with families and external healthcare professionals, and supporting the physical, emotional, and mental wellbeing of students. The role also carries significant responsibility for safeguarding and child protection, ensuring that student welfare and safety remain central to all aspects of nursing practice. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES ============================== ### Professional Nursing Practice \* Practise in accordance with Swiss nursing regulations, applicable professional standards, Croix\\-Rouge requirements, and NMC guidance (if applicable). \* Provide evidence\\-based, patient\\-centred nursing care. \* Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable Swiss data protection requirements. \* Maintain professional boundaries and uphold high standards of professional conduct. \* Participate in continuing professional development, mandatory training, and safeguarding education. \* Maintain competence in emergency response, first aid, medication administration, and relevant clinical procedures. ### Clinical Nursing Care \* Provide nursing care to students, staff, and visitors during scheduled shifts. \* Assess and manage acute and chronic illnesses, injuries, and health conditions. \* Conduct nursing assessments and develop appropriate care plans. \* Monitor students' health and recognise signs of deterioration requiring escalation or referral. \* Provide first aid and emergency care in accordance with relevant Swiss and Croix\\-Rouge standards. \* Refer students to doctors, hospitals, emergency services, or other healthcare professionals when clinically appropriate. \* Administer prescribed medications and treatments safely and maintain accurate medication records. \* Support vaccination programmes and infection prevention and control procedures in accordance with applicable Swiss guidance. \* Provide health advice and appropriate emotional support to students. \* Maintain accurate and contemporaneous electronic medical records. ### On Call and Overnight Nursing \* Remain on call and available throughout the scheduled shift to respond to student health needs. \* Respond promptly to urgent and unexpected illnesses, injuries, and medical concerns. \* Provide overnight nursing care and observation to unwell students. \* Monitor students in the Health Centre and, when required, coordinate care with boarding/house staff. \* Escalate concerns appropriately to senior clinical staff, parents, doctors, emergency services, or other healthcare professionals. \* Provide clear and accurate clinical handovers to ensure continuity of care. \* Maintain calm, professional decision\\-making during urgent and potentially stressful situations. ### Individual Student Care \* Develop and maintain individual health and care plans in collaboration with students, parents, house staff, wellbeing teams, and external healthcare professionals. \* Consider students' capacity to consent to treatment in accordance with applicable professional and legal requirements. \* Communicate with parents/guardians regarding significant illness, injury, treatment, and follow\\-up while respecting confidentiality. \* Support students with ongoing medical, physical, emotional, and wellbeing needs. \* Promote student independence and encourage appropriate self\\-management of health conditions. ### Safeguarding and Child Protection \* Actively promote and follow the school's Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy. \* Maintain awareness of indicators of abuse, neglect, exploitation, and other safeguarding concerns. \* Record safeguarding concerns accurately, objectively, and promptly. \* Report concerns immediately through the school's established safeguarding procedures and to the Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL). \* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries with students at all times. \* Participate in regular safeguarding and child\\-protection training. \* Contribute to a culture of vigilance, safety, and student welfare across the school community. ### Health Promotion and Education \* Promote healthy lifestyles and positive health behaviours among students. \* Provide age\\-appropriate health advice and education. \* Support school\\-wide wellbeing and pastoral initiatives. \* Contribute to health and wellbeing discussions, workshops, clinics, and educational activities. \* Keep up to date with relevant health promotion, adolescent health, and safeguarding guidance. ### Medication and Clinical Resources \* Safely administer, store, monitor, and document medications in accordance with prescriptions, care plans, and applicable regulations. \* Maintain appropriate medication records and stock control. \* Monitor expiry dates and ensure medications are stored securely. \* Maintain and restock first\\-aid kits and emergency medical supplies. \* Ensure appropriate storage and disposal of clinical waste and medical materials. \* Assist with ordering and distribution of medical supplies and equipment. ### Administration and Documentation \* Maintain accurate, confidential, and up\\-to\\-date medical records. \* Record all clinical consultations, assessments, treatments, medications, and interventions in the school's health database. \* Complete accident, incident, and medico\\-legal documentation when required. \* Support insurance\\-related documentation and reporting. \* Assist with Health Centre administration and daily operational requirements. \* Maintain appropriate records relating to medical supplies, expenditure, and resources. ### Health, Safety and Risk Management \* Promote health and safety within the Health Centre and wider school environment. \* Contribute to health\\-related risk assessments for school trips, residential activities, sports, events, and other activities. \* Provide advice regarding medical considerations and appropriate health precautions for school activities. \* Ensure Health Centre procedures comply with relevant health and safety requirements. \* Support infection prevention and control measures throughout the school. ### Communication and Multidisciplinary Collaboration \* Work collaboratively with nurses, doctors, boarding/house staff, teachers, pastoral teams, wellbeing staff, safeguarding staff, and school leadership. \* Liaise with parents and guardians regarding student healthcare needs. \* Coordinate care with external doctors, hospitals, therapists, specialists, and other healthcare professionals. \* Participate in multidisciplinary meetings relating to student health, welfare, and safeguarding. \* Provide effective clinical handovers to ensure continuity and safety of care. \* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all verbal and written communication. ### Working Hours \* Position with scheduled shifts that may include day, evening, night, weekend, and other unsocial hours. \* On call responsibilities are incorporated within the scheduled shift, requiring the nurse to remain available and responsive to student health needs throughout the assigned duty period.

Wir schaffen strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Chef der Armee und die Armeeführung und unterstützen sie dabei, die Entwicklung der Gruppe als Ganzes zu steuern. Unser Anspruch ist es, Strategie in organisationale Wirkung zu übersetzen – durch klare Prioritäten, kohärente Governance und konsequente Umsetzung.  

Als Chef des Teams verantwortest du zentrale strategische Fragestellungen an der Schnittstelle von militärischer und organisationaler Entwicklung. Du berätst das Senior Management, koordinierst organisationsübergreifende Vorhaben und stellst die Kohärenz der Organisationsentwicklung sicher. Gesucht wird eine integre, intellektuell neugierige Persönlichkeit, die analytische Tiefe mit pragmatischer Umsetzung verbindet, Verantwortung übernimmt und Wirkung erzielen will.

*  **Gelebte Vielfalt** Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
*  **Gesund am Arbeitsplatz** Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.


  **Ihr Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit**



Der Armeestab (A Stab) unterstützt den Chef der Armee in der Führung des Departementsbereichs Verteidigung und verantwortet die militärische Gesamtplanung und \-entwicklung der Schweizer Armee. Die Führung, Steuerung und Koordination sämtlicher übergreifender Querschnittsbereiche (Personal, Finanzen, Immobilien) fallen ebenfalls in den Zuständigkeitsbereich des Armeestabs.  

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
==============================

















Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
==============================



Workload: 100% / Workplace: Sursee
----------------------------------

  





Quality in every moment starts with YOU \- as an international fashion player, we operate in a highly dynamic environment. Excellence, innovation and sustainability are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you shape future\-ready Menswear and Kidswear collections that anticipate evolving consumer needs and translate them into distinctive, commercially successful product solutions. By combining creativity, consumer understanding and strategic thinking, you identify new opportunities, drive category growth and contribute to the future development of CALIDA's product offering. Together with your cross\-functional partners, you ensure that great product ideas become relevant, brand\-right and successful collections. Become part of the CALIDA Family and join us in shaping the textile future of tomorrow.





### Your Area of Responsibility





* You shape the Menswear and Kidswear category strategy and develop consumer\-relevant, brand\-right and commercially successful collections.
* You identify emerging consumer needs, market opportunities and category white spaces, translating them into impactful product concepts and category initiatives.
* You own the assortment and price architecture across the product life cycle, balancing consumer appeal, profitability and sustainability.
* You analyse market, consumer and product performance data and translate insights into clear commercial actions, forecasts and growth opportunities.
* You drive category performance and profitability in close collaboration with the Director Product \& Design, Design, Merchandising, and work closely with Operations, Marketing, and Controlling.
* You are equally comfortable analysing business performance, discussing product opportunities and driving execution to deliver results
* You challenge the status quo and continuously explore new ideas, innovative product concepts and opportunities to strengthen category relevance and future growth.
* You lead and develop Product Managers, set priorities and ensure high\-quality execution across the category.
* You coordinate collection\-related information and presentations across teams and support a successful go\-to\-market.
* You continuously improve processes, tools and ways of working and contribute to strategic cross\-functional projects.



### What We Value





* You have 8\+ years of experience in Product or Category Management within the apparel or textile industry; bodywear or nightwear experience is a plus.
* You have a degree in Business Administration, Apparel Management or a comparable field and bring strong apparel and textile expertise.
* You combine creativity, consumer curiosity and a strong sense for trends with strategic, analytical and commercial thinking.
* You understand how to connect consumer needs, brand objectives and business goals to create relevant and successful assortments.
* You take ownership, set clear priorities and turn ideas into action with an entrepreneurial and hands\-on mindset.
* You bring leadership experience and enjoy developing people and collaborating across functions.
* You are a confident communicator and presenter with a structured, quality\-focused way of working.
* You are fluent in and English and willing to travel when needed.









  

  



  



### Your Benefits













* Flexible working hours with mobile/remote working options









* Professional and personal development opportunities, including financial support for further education and career advancement









* Coverage of KTG (daily sickness benefits insurance) and NBU (non\-occupational accident insurance) premiums









* Free parking for all employees at the headquarters and discounted meals in our staff restaurant, Yellows









* Enjoy unforgettable moments at our regular CALIDA Yellow's aperitifs and our unique Christmas party









* Attractive employee discounts on our brands and regular outlet sales events









  



### Your contact















  **Ms**  
  
HR Specialist  
  
  
  
  



  



### Are you ready?



Our Recruitment Process

You can expect a transparent and personal recruitment process that puts your skills and personality at the centre.



**1\. Digital Check\-in (1 hour)**  
Start your journey with a virtual interview via Teams. It's an opportunity to get to know each other and learn more about your potential role \- all from the comfort of your home.



**2\. In\-person Meeting at our Headquarters in Sursee (2\-3 hours)**  
Following a successful first interview, we'll invite you to our headquarters in Sursee. You'll dive deeper into the role, meet the team in person and get a feel for our working environment during an office tour.



We only consider applications submitted through our careers page. For this position, we are unable to consider candidate profiles submitted by recruitment agencies.

title: Marketing Manager Switzerland
description:
Do you want to shape the future of marketing across Switzerland turning business priorities into high-impact campaigns, client experiences and measurable growth?

This Marketing Manager role will be based in Zurich and embedded in the Swiss sales team. The candidate will be a high-impact partner to sales, translating business priorities into real-world marketing events and data-driven marketing programs that drive client acquisition, deepen engagement, accelerate pipeline growth, and contribute directly to growth.

The role is a hands-on one that combines commercial strategy, client journey expertise, digital marketing execution, and performance analysis to maximize marketing's contribution to business growth across institutional, and intermediary client segments.
The Marketing Manager Switzerland serves as a strategic partner to sales, translating business priorities into data-driven marketing programs that drive client acquisition, deepen engagement, accelerate pipeline growth, and contribute to Net New Money (NNM). The role combines commercial strategy, client journey expertise, digital marketing excellence, and performance analytics to maximize marketing's contribution to business growth across institutional, wholesale, and intermediary client segments.

Key responsibilities


Commercial growth & business partnership

Partner with sales and client portfolio managers to identify growth opportunities and support business objectives.
Develop and deliver market, segment and account-based marketing plans in close partnership with Sales, translating commercial priorities, sales strategy and client needs into impactful marketing programs that support NNM targets.
Translate business challenges into measurable marketing initiatives that support client acquisition, retention and cross-selling opportunities.
Act as a trusted partner to business stakeholders on growth strategy and marketing investment decisions.
Build strong partnerships across sales, marketing, content, communications, compliance and external agencies.
Influence senior stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations and commercial insights.
Represent the voice of the market by bringing client feedback, competitive intelligence and emerging opportunities into planning discussions.
Plan and execute proprietary client events, conferences, industry forums and other high-impact client engagement opportunities.

Client journey & demand generation

Own and optimize end-to-end client journeys across priority client segments.
Design and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns that generate engagement, pipeline and commercial outcomes.
Identify conversion opportunities and remove friction points across the marketing funnel.
Drive adoption of digital engagement programs and scalable growth initiatives.

Data, insights & performance management

Establish clear KPIs linked to pipeline creation, marketing influence, client engagement, conversion and business growth.
Use CRM, marketing automation and analytics platforms to measure performance and optimize investment decisions.
Turn data and client insights into actionable recommendations for commercial teams.
Continuously test, learn and improve campaign effectiveness
What are we looking for?


Experience & skills

8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, client engagement or commercial marketing.
Strong understanding of the Swiss financial services, asset management or wealth management landscape.
Proven track record of strategic thinking and linking marketing investment to pipeline growth and business outcomes.
Proficient working with CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics and performance measurement (M365, Salesforce, MC Cloud, Snowflake, Power BI)
Strong commercial and entrepreneurial acumen and ability to engage credibly with sales leadership.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
Strong understanding of asset management markets and regulatory requirements across regional markets
Fluent German and English; French is advantageous.

What do we offer?

Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.
Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.
Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.
Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.


At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.


We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form.

Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



















Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL  









The Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL is part of the ETH Domain. Approximately 600 people work on the sustainable use and protection of the environment and on the handling of natural hazards.



The Research Unit Forest and Soil Ecology assesses the impact of climate change and management on forests and their soils. The group Critical Zone dynamics is offering a **two\-year position** as



Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



You will work within the recently funded SNSF project FIRE ("Fire Impacts on the Response of terrestrial Ecosystems"). This project investigates how wildfires affect carbon cycling and transit times at the landscape scale, particularly in the deeper unsaturated zone and in groundwater, and over longer periods of time. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team of collaborators based in Switzerland and the USA, and support the team in conducting geochemical analysis (particularly radiocarbon) on environmental samples from recently burned landscapes in the USA. Your main tasks will involve preparation of a range of sample types (gaseous, aqueous, and solid) for stable carbon isotope and radiocarbon analysis. This will be done in collaboration with our partners at the Laboratory for Beam Physics at ETH Zurich, where you will also frequently work. Processing of samples for other types of analysis, e.g., major ion concentrations, general chemistry, will also be part of your duties. You will support and train a PhD candidate and guests from our partner universities in the USA in laboratory procedures. Moreover, you will also assist the team with administrative and logistical duties, e.g., the shipping of samples and materials to and from field sites in the USA.





You preferably hold a Master's degree in environmental or earth sciences or related disciplines, and have demonstrated experience with mass spectrometric methods for geochemical analysis and/or radiocarbon methods. You are familiar with laboratory work, enjoy contributing to methodological advancements, and are interested in interdisciplinary and international research. You are able to work independently, are structured and accurate, communicative and team\-oriented. You have very good written and spoken English language skills. You will be part of a vibrant research group and an international team of leading researchers in biogeosciences, paleoclimatology, and terrestrial geochemistry. The position is based at WSL and initially fixed to two years with the option for prolongation for\- additional two years.



Please send your complete application to Pe, Human Resources WSL, by uploading the requested documents through our webpage. Review of the applications will begin on October 22, 2026\. Applications via email will not be considered. Lechleitner, , will be happy to answer any questions or offer further information. WSL is committed to diversity and inclusion as core values. We actively promote gender equality and foster an open, inclusive work environment.

title: Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for MSF Boards and Associations
description:
SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE
The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, and associative spaces free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for Boards and Associations supports the implementation, operationalisation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of MSF’s safeguarding work with boards and associations across the MSF movement. This reflects the International Board’s commitment to minimum standards for safeguarding in associative networks.

The role:
leads coordination and implementation efforts that translate safeguarding principles, commitments, policies, and standards into practical, measurable, consistent, coherent, and sustainable safeguarding practices across MSF’s boards and associative structures.

advances safeguarding culture change by supporting MSF boards in understanding their role in safeguarding leadership and oversight; and by supporting the development of robust safeguarding understanding and putting in place safeguarding measures within associative structures and associations.

contributes to strengthening prevention, detection, reporting, response to safeguarding cases.

promotes accountability and institutional learning on safeguarding across the MSF movement.

ACCOUNTABILITIES
Coordination, design, and implementation :
Lead the coordination, implementation, and training on the ELMS, as well as on safeguarding, and other ethics principles within MSF boards.
Translate safeguarding and ELMS concepts into actionable documents, processes, and initiatives for MSF boards associations/networks in line with existing MSF initiatives on safeguarding.
Develop implementation guidance, tools, frameworks, templates, and operational resources.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding ambitions are translated into practical implementation plans and deliverables.
Implementation progress is systematically tracked, monitored, and reported.
Approaches, tools, trainings, and guidance are developed and used by relevant stakeholders.

Drive safeguarding culture change :
Drive integration of safeguarding as a core organizational practice across MSF boards and associations.
Strengthen safeguarding accountability and leadership engagement, and ownership.
Other tasks assigned by the ISC or the International President or their delegate.

Lead monitoring, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement on Safeguarding and Ethical Governance :
Monitor implementation progress, identify risks and gaps, and drive corrective and improvement actions where needed.
Analyze ELMS and safeguarding implementation, challenges, and lessons learned to inform strategic decision-making.
Produce implementation reports, dashboards, briefing papers, presentations, and governance updates.
Lead learning and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to safeguarding and ELMS implementation and best practices.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding is embedded into MSF associations and boards’ ways of working.
Safeguarding considerations are integrated into associative and boards’ processes.
Organisational awareness and ownership of safeguarding responsibilities is increased across the MSF associations and boards.

Coordinate the framework and response to ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership :
Ensure relevant frameworks and processes relating to triage, case management, investigation, and decision-making are implemented for ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership (the incumbent will not engage, case management, investigations or decision-making directly, but rather ensure it is in place).
Reception, and coordination, initial review and assessment of safeguarding and ELMs allegations involving senior leadership (i.e. General Directors and board members). Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for ELMS-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

Key Accountabilities :
Ensure that ELMs related complaints are properly assigned to relevant experts for case management/investigation.
Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for safeguarding or ELMs-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY
The role is responsible under the technical supervision of the ISC and the hierarchical supervision of the International President (or the IP’s delegate). The role will coordinate closely with:
the Board Strengthening Programme concerning board training and direct board support activities with respect to safeguarding and ELMS implementation.
the International Associative Team to ensure appropriate association support and training activities with respect to safeguarding.
the ILD to ensure legal risks and statutory requirements are duly considered.

The role uses subject matter expertise, analysis, independent judgement and translates safeguarding, and ethical governance initiatives (such as the Ethical Leadership and Minimum Standards), and other safeguarding initiatives and concepts into relatable, understood, actionable documents, trainings, and actionable initiatives that support to ensure all parts of MSF have a robust understanding of, and structures that support safeguarding.

The role needs a strong understanding of, safeguarding policies, codes of conducts-including ethical governance principles, and how to draft them for associations (non-staff), alongside an understanding of the role of trustees and Boards as oversight for safeguarding.

The incumbent will also need to understand case management and administrative investigations to be able to explain these concepts and how they relate to oversight and associations.

The incumbent will also need to have good understanding of confidentiality, and act with the utmost discretion, when following up, and arranging that safeguarding and ELMs complaints involving senior leadership are properly and promptly addressed.

Job requirements
Education
A master's degree in relevant field such as law, human rights, administration etc. Or a bachelor's degree combined with significant relevant experience in safeguarding, governance of non-profits.

Experience

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Illnau-Effretikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Illnau-Effretikon liegt in der Zürcher Landschaft und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Infrastruktur. Die Region ist dank der S-Bahn-Anbindung schnell mit Zürich verbunden und besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Natur und Erholungsräumen. Zahlreiche etablierte Unternehmen haben sich hier angesiedelt, was ein vielfältiges Angebot an Arbeitsstellen schafft. Sie profitieren von günstigen Mieten gegenüber der Stadt, während Sie gleichzeitig urban erreichbar bleiben.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Gruppenleitung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Mit Ihrer Qualifikation auf HF/FH-Niveau eröffnen sich Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere in Alters- und Pflegeheimen sowie Spitälern. iPersonal vereinfacht Ihren Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, fundierte Kenntnisse des regionalen Marktes und die Begleitung beim Bewerbungsprozess, sodass Sie schnell eine passende Führungsposition finden.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Senior Robotics Engineer / Postdoctoral Researcher 60\-100 %
============================================================





We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher or senior robotics engineer. Take humanoid and quadruped robots out of the lab and into industry: with Swiss partners, you deploy reinforcement learning, robot foundation models and agentic systems in the real world.

Senior Robotics Engineer / Postdoctoral Researcher 60\-100 %
============================================================



**School:**



School of Engineering



**Starting date:**



January 2027 or by appointment.



**Your role**







* You conduct applied research and development as a senior robotics engineer / postdoctoral researcher in the Embodied Mobile Agents (EMA) research group, deploying reinforcement learning and VLA/WAM policies on humanoid and quadruped robots in the real world.
* You drive our current focus topics: flexible industrial automation through agentic embodied AI systems, robotic foundation models and reinforcement learning for mobile manipulation. In a new project, we will be looking into lowering the entry barrier to robot teleoperation and imitation learning for non\-technical users through automated dataset curation and real\-time feedback.
* You turn results into publications and open\-source code contributions.
* You collaborate with companies, universities and other partners in Switzerland and the EU. Most of our projects are applied research and innovation projects with Swiss companies, mainly funded by Innosuisse.


**Your profile**







* You hold a PhD in robotics, or in computer science or a related field with a focus on AI for robotics.
* You are a pragmatic "maker" with a strong drive to build things that work and are appealing to use, and you have hands\-on experience with real robots, including prototyping and modifying robots with off\-the\-shelf equipment.
* You have proven competencies in robot learning (reinforcement learning, imitation learning, robot foundation models) and in classical robotics (motion planning, perception and navigation, teleoperation).
* You are a strong programmer and work confidently with ROS / ROS 2, Nav2, MoveIt, PCL, OpenCV, the NVIDIA Jetson ecosystem and current deep learning frameworks.
* You have a strong research track record in AI for robotics or computer vision, shown by publications, and your curiosity keeps you on top of the state of the art.
* You are fluent in English; is a plus.
* We offer a position at the level of research associate, initially limited to 2 years.


**This is what we stand for**



Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  

The School of Engineering ( ), as one of the leading educational and research institutions in Switzerland, focuses on topics relevant to the future. 14 institutes and centres guarantee high\-quality education, research and development with a focus on the areas of energy, mobility, information and health.  

The Centre for Artificial Intelligence ( ) maintains a growing number of research groups in four strategic focus areas: . The CAI conducts method\-focused applied re\-search and development at the highest level in the field of machine learning and is committed to a human\-centered ap\-proach to artificial intelligence, thereby actively shaping the ethical dimension.  

We are looking for a witty, sharp, curious, and technically skilled personality. We value potential over formally certified skills, encouraging also unconventional CVs, e.g., transdisciplinary backgrounds or own entrepreneurial experience. Please honor us with a tailored cover letter and highlight facts that underline your ability to achieve high. We are looking forward to hearing from you!  

ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.

We offer working conditions and terms of employment commensurate with higher education institutions and actively promote personal development for staff in leadership and non\-leadership positions. Die **MEWA Service AG** gehört zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich nachhaltiges Textilmanagement und steht seit über 100 Jahren für Qualität, Innovation und durchdachte Full\-Service\-Lösungen. Was einst mit wiederverwendbaren Putztüchern begann, hat sich zu einer international erfolgreichen Unternehmensgruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden und Standorten in ganz Europa entwickelt. Gerade die Kombination aus hochwertigen Produkten, persönlichem Service und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen macht das Unternehmen seit Jahren erfolgreich. Gleichzeitig bietet MEWA ein modernes, stabiles Umfeld mit klaren Strukturen, hoher Kundenorientierung und langfristiger Perspektive.







Im Zuge des weiteren Wachstums suchen wir im **exklusiven Mandatsauftrag** eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit einem starken Team den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln möchte.



Quereinstieg. Remote. Vertriebsassistentin Outbound
===================================================







**Dein Alltag**



Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, gehst offen auf andere zu und schaffst es, mit deiner sympathischen Interesse zu wecken? Dann bietet dir diese Position die ideale Möglichkeit, in den Vertrieb einzusteigen und dich langfristig weiterzuentwickeln – **auch als Quereinstieg möglich.**







Als wichtige Unterstützung des Account Managers bist du die erste Ansprechperson für potenzielle Neukunden und legst den Grundstein für erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen. Mit deiner offenen kontaktierst du Unternehmen telefonisch, identifizierst interessante Ansprechpartner und vereinbarst Termine für den Account Manager. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du bei der Planung der Kundenbesuche und sorgst dafür, dass Verkaufsaktivitäten optimal vorbereitet sind. Darüber hinaus recherchierst du neue potenzielle Kunden, erweiterst die bestehende Datenbank und trägst aktiv dazu bei, neue Marktpotenziale zu erschliessen. Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen, deiner Hartnäckigkeit und deiner positiven leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum Vertriebserfolg.







**Dein Profil**



* Freude am Telefonieren und am aktiven Austausch mit Menschen
* Kommunikationsstarke, offene und sympathische Persönlichkeit
* Überzeugungskraft sowie ein sicheres und selbstbewusstes Auftreten
* Organisationstalent und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Eigeninitiative, Zielorientierung und Durchhaltevermögen
* Freude daran, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und Chancen zu erkennen
* Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil






**Deine Benefits**



Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung und einem hohen Mass an Flexibilität. Du arbeitest vollständig aus dem Homeoffice und profitierst gleichzeitig von den Strukturen, der Stabilität und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens. Neben einem Fixlohn profitierst du von einem leistungsorientierten Provisionsmodell mit entsprechendem Verdienstpotenzial und überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. \-La AG in Basel, we are looking for a

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Project Engineering – CQV to lead Commissioning, Qualification and Validation (CQV) activities across a portfolio of biopharmaceutical CAPEX projects in Visp, Switzerland.

In this role, you will combine technical expertise, project management and team leadership to ensure that facilities, equipment and manufacturing processes are commissioned and qualified in accordance with GEP/cGMP requirements, quality standards, project schedules and budgets.

Infirmier
=========

 

### Introduction

 

Vous êtes passionné(e) par les soins infirmiers et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et bienveillante ? Ô Santé Sàrl, une entreprise de soins à domicile dédiée à la santé et au bien\-être, recherche un(e) Infirmier(ère) motivé(e) pour renforcer son équipe en Suisse. Si vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité enrichissante dans un environnement stimulant, cette offre est faite pour vous !

 

### Responsabilités

 

En tant qu'Infirmier(ère) chez Ô Santé Sàrl, vos principales missions incluront :

* Assurer des soins infirmiers de qualité aux patients, en respectant les protocoles et les normes en vigueur.
* Évaluer les besoins des patients et élaborer des plans de soins personnalisés.
* Collaborer avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire pour garantir un suivi optimal des patients.
* Assurer la gestion et le suivi des dossiers médicaux.
* Participer à l'éducation thérapeutique des patients et de leurs familles.
* Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques et des services de soins.


 

### Qualifications

 

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez répondre aux critères suivants :

* Diplôme reconnu d'Infirmier(ère) (HES ou équivalent).
* Autorisation de pratiquer en Suisse (croix rouge si nécessaire).
* Expérience préalable en soins infirmiers, idéalement dans un environnement similaire.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en relation interpersonnelle.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
* Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit) ; la connaissance d'autres langues est un atout.
* Flexibilité et capacité d'adaptation à des situations variées.


 

### Avantages

 

En rejoignant Ô Santé Sàrl, vous bénéficierez de :

* Un environnement de travail stimulant et bienveillant.
* Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.
* Un salaire compétitif et des avantages sociaux attractifs.
* Un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
* Une équipe soudée et collaborative.


 

### Informations pour postuler

 

Si vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi et à contribuer à l'excellence des soins chez Ô Santé Sàrl, nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature via notre site internet. Nous avons hâte de découvrir votre profil et de vous accueillir dans notre équipe !

Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist
====================================







**Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist:** **Pharmaceutical Chemical Process/ chemical drawing tools / R\&D / CDMO / Design of Experiments / Synthetic Organic Chemistry / Leadership \& Project Management / Manufacturing / GMP**/ **English / Deutsch**



  **Background:**



In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late\-stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



The ideal candidate is a PhD/PostDoc\-level organic chemist with 5\+ years of pharmaceutical R\&D experience specializing in late\-stage process optimization and scale\-up. They bring demonstrated leadership in guiding internal project teams and managing CDMO operations, technical transfers, and material supply. Fluent in English, they marry outstanding scientific acumen with strong organizational skills. They are an articulate, collaborative communicator who effectively motivates teams to deliver safe, scalable, and sustainable chemical processes.







  **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* Lead Internal \& External Chemical Process R\&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1\-5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).
* Oversee end\-to\-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale\-up, and support for supply activities.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost\-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
* Ensure Quality \& Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.


  



  **Must Haves:**



* PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R\&D, with demonstrated expertise in late\-stage process development and scale\-up.
* Leadership \& Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
* CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
* Technical \& Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale\-up simulation software is a plus.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.


  



  **Nice to Haves:**



* Familiarity or prior experience working within Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environments is an advantage, though not strictly required.
* Professional working proficiency or fluency in is a plus.

title: Approvisionneur Junior B2B – Gastronomie Asiatique & Japonaise
description:
*Contexte de l'entreprise : Importation et distribution B2B de produits alimentaires, boissons et arts de la table haut de gamme, destinés à la gastronomie japonaise et asiatique (restaurants, épiceries fines, chaînes de restauration). Flux logistiques internationaux complexes (Grand Import) et gestion de produits périssables multi\-températures (sec, frais, surgelé).*

**1\. IDENTIFICATION DU POSTE**

**Intitulé du poste :** Approvisionneur Junior / Gestionnaire de Flux Import B2B

**Rattachement hiérarchique :** Responsable Approvisionnements / Responsable Supply Chain

**Interfaces internes :** Acheteurs, Commerciaux, Transitaires, Responsable Entrepôt/Logistique

**Interfaces externes :** Fournisseurs internationaux (Asie/Japon/US/UE), Transporteurs, Commissionnaires en douane

**2\. MISSION PRINCIPALE**

Sous la supervision du Responsable Approvisionnements, l'Approvisionneur Junior assure la disponibilité optimale des produits phares de la gastronomie asiatique (épicerie, produits frais/surgelés, sakés, packagings client) tout en garantissant un niveau de stock maîtrisé. Il gère l'intégralité du flux d'approvisionnement depuis la passation de commande à l'international jusqu'à la livraison finale à l'entrepôt logistique B2B, dans le respect strict des réglementations douanières et sanitaires propres à l'agroalimentaire.

Nous recherchons une personne motivée, dynamique et proactive, qui fait preuve d’initiative et d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

Vous êtes capable de prendre du recul face aux situations, d’identifier les problèmes et de proposer des solutions concrètes, plutôt que de vous arrêter aux difficultés rencontrées.

Vous avez le sens des responsabilités, êtes autonome et savez faire preuve de remise en question. Vous accueillez les remarques constructives avec ouverture et les considérez comme des occasions de progresser.

Une bonne base de connaissances dans le domaine est souhaitée, mais une longue expérience n’est pas indispensable. Nous accordons davantage d’importance à votre motivation, à votre capacité de réflexion et à votre volonté d’apprendre.

Une formation et un accompagnement seront assurés afin de vous permettre de développer vos compétences et d’évoluer dans votre fonction.

**3\. MISSIONS ET ACTIVITÉS LOGISTIQUES**

**A. Gestion opérationnelle des importations (grand import \+ europe)**

**Calculer et planifier :** les besoins de commandes selon l'état des stocks, les prévisions de ventes commerciales et la saisonnalité des produits (ex: pics de fin d'année, festivals).

**Saisir et émettre :** les commandes d'achat internationales dans l'ERP d'après le catalogue des fournisseurs référencés.

**Coordonner :** le transport international (FCL/LCL maritime, aérien) en lien direct avec les transitaires et optimiser le taux de remplissage des conteneurs.

**Sécuriser :** la bonne constitution des dossiers d'importation (factures, Bill of Lading, certificats sanitaires d'origine, certificats de non\-radiation, agréments phytosanitaires).

**B. Pilotage des stocks et respect de la chaîne de valeur agroalimentaire**

**Surveiller la rotation :** les dates limites de consommation (DLC) et dates de durabilité minimale (DDM) afin de minimiser la démarque sur les produits ultra\-frais et secs.

**Ajuster en continu :** les niveaux de stock par rapport à la capacité de stockage multi\-températures de l'entrepôt (sec, frais à \+4°C, surgelé à \-18°C).

Consultant en recrutement IT \- H/F
===================================

Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.

Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.

### Description du poste

**Votre mission**

En tant que **Consultant·e en recrutement IT**, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe Sigmalis que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.

**Vos principales responsabilités**

* Comprendre les besoins de recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés,
* Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées,
* Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées,
* Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête,
* Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste,
* Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés,
* Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien précis permettant de restituer les compétences, l'expérience, les motivations et les éléments déterminants de chaque candidature,
* Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel,
* Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés,
* Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs,
* Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeur.


### Profil recherché

Vous bénéficiez de 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le sourcing et le recrutement de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques **en Suisse romande**.

Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes :

* excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête,
* bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et environnements de l'informatique,
* connaissance du marché de l'emploi et du tissu économique de Suisse romande,
* capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV,
* français langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones,
* sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément,
* excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication,
* autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats,
* goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers,
* respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement.


Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite s'investir dans la durée, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité.

**Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est…**

**Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine**, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles.

**Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur**, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements.

**Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT**, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients.

**Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats**, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement.

**Travailler sur des missions variées**, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande.

Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à **l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients**.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ?

Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature et d'échanger avec vous sur votre parcours et vos aspirations professionnelles.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, nous recevrons avec plaisir votre candidature qui doit comprendre votre cv **ainsi que votre dossier complet (copies de diplômes, certificats de travail, etc…).**  

**Nous ne répondrons qu'aux profils qui correspondent à ces pré\-requis.**
